brief.zh: 测试人员要保护授权、失败后输入保留和正常提交。对原创建模程序的缺陷版与修复版逐条执行测试，保留期望、实际输出和失败，而不是一律写通过。
brief.en: A tester protects an API/UI behavior matrix before and after a fix. Run each supplied case and retain both expected and actual outputs.

zh: 失败诊断、确认与回归报告
en: Executable regression cases and linked failures

zh: 坏版本出现预期失败、修复版通过
清理和隔离避免测试顺序污染
en: Reconcile the complete result with the supplied input IDs and values.
A blanket passed label conceals a failing case in the broken version. This is a blocking regression.

failure.zh: 测试只查HTTP200或界面标题而漏关键行为应暴露
failure.en: A blanket passed label conceals a failing case in the broken version.

en: Locate the decision and supporting input/result in your deliverables.
Explain remaining uncertainty, your contribution and what the receiving role must verify.

environment.scope: Original small deterministic teaching application; no real enterprise traffic or model inference

zh: 测试人员要保护授权、失败后输入保留和正常提交。对原创建模程序的缺陷版与修复版逐条执行测试，保留期望、实际输出和失败，而不是一律写通过。
测试只查HTTP200或界面标题而漏关键行为应暴露；先制作能暴露这项错误的最小检查。
逐个核对输入和产物位置，保留修订前后、本人贡献与尚未验证范围。
en: A tester protects an API/UI behavior matrix before and after a fix.
Reproduce this failure first: A blanket passed label conceals a failing case in the broken version.
Check every result ID and preserve a before/after record; explain what this fixture cannot establish.

variants.scope: Fixed reviewed scenario and explicit extension. New constraints require a new review.
